create_GJKResult_struct: create a GJKResult struct to hold distance, witness points, simplex, and dimension from GJK collision detection
create_Polytope_struct: create a Polytope struct to hold vertices, faces, and horizon data for EPA collision refinement
create_SupportPoint_struct: create a SupportPoint struct to hold a support point, cached index, and vertex index for a geom
run_gjk_collision: run the GJK algorithm to find the distance and witness points between two convex geoms within a tolerance
run_ccd_collision_detection: run convex collision detection via GJK and EPA to recover penetration depth and contact points between two geoms
run_multicontact_recovery: run multicontact recovery to extract multiple contact witness points from an EPA polytope for box and mesh geoms
